question.text: In a hydrogen atom, if energy of an electron in ground state is 13.6 eV, then that in the 2nd excited state is

solution.text:
$2^{\text {nd }}$ excited state will be the 3 rd energy level
$$
\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{n}}=\frac{13.6}{\mathrm{n}^2} \mathrm{eV} \text { or } \mathrm{E}=\frac{13.6}{9} \mathrm{eV}=1.51 \mathrm{eV}
$$
